weather_report:
Subiaco sits in the small hours under a quilt of cloud, the air still and slightly damp, the horizon smudged in charcoal. A light sprinkle is poised to slip through around dawn, giving way to a steady overcast that flattens the light and mutes the colors. Sunshine will be shy at best; expect a dull, pearly glow rather than beams, with UV on the low side through the morning and only a modest rise if the cloud thins later. The day looks clear enough to see your way, yet indistinct at the edges, as if the town were drawn in pencil instead of ink.

It won’t be harsh, just subdued and a touch cool. A light layer and a waterproof shell will serve, with closed shoes and a small umbrella in the bag. An early amble between showers, a quiet tram ride to fetch bread, or a tidy of the desk suits the mood. When doors open, a brief library visit or grocery run feels right; if the sky offers a paler patch by late morning, step out for a coffee and keep an eye on the clouds. Sunscreen only if the day brightens; otherwise, lip balm and unhurried patience.
